artifact.cameraDescription: Flap Fit uses the front camera to track exercise movement and control your bird. Camera images are processed live on your device. If you choose Record & Play, the app creates a temporary local recording for you to share; Flap Fit does not upload it.
artifact.microphoneDescription: Flap Fit uses the microphone only when you choose Record & Play, so your voice and workout sounds can be included in the temporary video you control.
